materials.name: Pyralux AP 9111
materials.peel_condition: as fabricated and after solder (9 lb/in)
materials.notes: Dielectric (polyimide) thickness 1.0 mil. Tg 220 C is published without a method and is not stored; in-plane CTE 25 ppm/C below Tg (40 est. above Tg); modulus 700 kpsi (4.83 GPa); dielectric strength 6-7 kV/mil; surface resistance more than 10^16 ohm; moisture and insulation resistance 10^11 ohm; tensile strength more than 345 MPa; elongation more than 50 %; flexural endurance 6000 cycles at least; solder float at 288 C passes; dielectric thickness tolerance 10 %; maximum operating temperature 180 C. Initiation tear 700-1000 g, propagation tear more than 10 g. Add R (rolled-annealed), E (electro-deposited) or D (double-treat RA) to the product code to choose the copper foil.
